evidence.finding: Server central hub (SQLite, HTTP API, WebSocket); host daemon per execution machine provisions workspaces and runs providers; App web UI inspects projects/threads and steers; CLI bb first-class same as app. Project top container with sources; Thread unit of work with lifecycle and append-only events, standard or manager coordinating children, can own child threads; Environment binds workspace dir to host (unmanaged or managed, cleaned when unarchived); Host long-lived daemon identity with primary + enrolled remotes. Contracts @cloudroom/server-contract and host-daemon-contract.

evidence.title: Using bb on multiple devices
evidence.locator: Open from another browser; Use Cloudroom on your phone; Open another Mac; Add execution machine
evidence.finding: Browser device is control surface for one server (view projects, send prompts, manage threads, no execution). Cloudroom Connect via cloudroom.run relay; phone runs same app as PWA at app.cloudroom.run (open cloudroom.dev/m, Add to Home Screen); no mobile push (system notifications only in open desktop/browser tabs). Settings Machines lists Macs on same account (Open/Run threads on it, 30-day sign-in, renews weekly). Add machine installs host-only bb-app package with SHA-256 verified installer; each server gets own daemon instance.

evidence.title: Configuration
evidence.locator: Cloudroom connection; Cloudroom CLI; Packaged desktop; BB configuration; Push notifications; Keep Awake
evidence.finding: Connection in ~/.gui-cloudroom cloudroom.json (url/token/projectId 0600) via POST /api/v1/cloudroom. Use room-cli not bb; standalone defaults 127.0.0.1:39886 daemon 39887; room-cli status/thread/machine commands same backend for Local and Cloud threads. Packaged app uses server 39886/daemon 39887 and ~/.gui-cloudroom. Push notifications plugin has webEnabled/desktopEnabled true default; browsers need HTTPS/localhost + permission; bb push-notifications test broadcasts. Keep Awake runs caffeinate on selected macOS hosts; closing lid still sleeps. Telemetry disabled via Settings Privacy or bb settings general telemetryEnabled false or BB_TELEMETRY=false.

evidence.title: Worktrees, setup scripts, and teardown scripts
evidence.locator: Managed worktree; Start thread in worktree; Move running thread; .worktreeinclude; .bb-env-setup.sh
evidence.finding: Managed worktree is git worktree of project repo on fresh branch at <DATA>/plugins/environment-git-worktree/host-data/worktrees/<thread>/<repo>; shares .git, cheap, parallel threads. Pick Worktree in environment picker or pnpm bb thread spawn --new-environment worktree. room-cli thread worktree moves Local thread keeping ID/chat; uncommitted files stay unless --carry (Claude/Codex only). .worktreeinclude copies untracked files (gitignore syntax) before setup; .bb-env-setup.sh runs inside owned path (15-min timeout, failure blocks provisioning). Cleanup saves branch and removes folder when all threads archived.

evidence.title: Loop/automation implementation
evidence.locator: Module docs, USAGE string and check() trigger validation
evidence.finding: room-cli loop/automation create supports --cron 5-field with --timezone, --at, --in and --webhook triggers; every-minute runs with a script, else at most every 15 minutes; website every-minute cron wakes the sandbox, sends the prompt and computes the next run so Core never parses cron; fresh-thread loops save settings to survive archive; scripts gate runs with 3 consecutive failures pausing the loop; report records outcome done/acted/needs-you/failed with confidence, reason and actions; webhook loops print a secret URL once with hook rotation.
